item.title: ‘HE’S LOVED BY EVERYONE,’ NYGREN WELCOMES BACK O’NEILL
item.description: MARTIN O’NEILL singled out Benjamin Nygren as he said his farewells to the Celtic players following the 1-0 win over Dundee at Parkhead on Wednesday December 3. item.title: NO GO KYOGO, ADMITS O’NEILL
item.description: FORMER fans’ favourite Kyogo Furuhashi will NOT be staging a remarkable comeback to Celtic. Martin O’Neill has admitted it would be “unlikely” that the Japanese striker, who collected 85 goals in 165 games in his first spell at the club, will be returning.
